identity_law.project_id: Durable human umbrella; may contain multiple Chat Objects.
identity_law.chat_object_id: Durable conversational/operational identity that survives ChatGPT conversation replacement.
identity_law.workstream_id: Durable Prometeo execution/coordination stream; a Chat Object may coordinate several.
identity_law.work_item_id: One durable delegated job prepared before a worker conversation exists.
identity_law.worker_instance_id: Disposable incarnation/execution identity. Reincarnating the Chat Object may create a new worker_instance_id while chat_object_id remains stable.
identity_law.launch_code: Temporary human-friendly address to a durable work_item/JOB, never authority or task state.
identity_law.conversation_id: Optional ChatGPT platform evidence when exposed; never required for recovery.
